status: registered before human annotation and before any model run on the v0.5 pack
supersedes_nothing: MS-150..155 verdicts and their preregs stay as recorded. This does not re-judge them.
purpose: One decision experiment that tells us where to spend the next block of time. It does NOT try to prove that memory helps. Following docs/PLAN_GROUNDED_CHANGE_MEMORY_2026_09_22.md section 9b.
question: On the v0.5 visible-contract episodes, (H) can people read the question consistently, (L) do simple budgeted selectors drop the evidence people needed, and (R) do frozen VLMs answer from image content under a matched-content control?

data.scope: 6 AOIs, 12 episodes, 172 PNG frames, SpaceNet 7 monthly Planet mosaics at native crop resolution
known_limits: exposed development split: these AOIs were already used in v0.1-v0.4; not an untouched test set
the target is the first PROVIDED observation that clearly shows change, not the physical onset date and not a detection-latency measurement
a before/after pair shows that change exists but does not by itself prove it is the FIRST such observation

stage_H_human_readability.protocol: docs/SN7_VISIBLE_CONTRACT_V05_IMPLEMENTATION_2026_09_22.md; annotators see only frames up to cutoff, no candidate hints, no model answers, no polygons
stage_H_human_readability.budget: hard cap 10 person-hours total (2 annotators x 5h). The cap is a ceiling, not a target; stop early when all 12 episodes are covered twice.
metrics: readable_rate = episodes where both annotators produced a non-timeout answer
agreement_rate = episodes whose full agreed target is derivable (consensus_target succeeds)
first_change_id disagreement in observations, for episodes where both said change_supported

gate.pass: agreement_rate >= 0.60 over the 12 episodes AND at least one agreed episode in each of change_supported / no_visible_change / insufficient_evidence
gate.fail_reading: if agreement is below 0.60 or a class is empty, the question/변화 단위 is not consistently readable by people on this data; stages L and R are not run and the SN7 memory line is closed for now

stage_L_evidence_loss.runs_on: agreed targets only; no VLM, CPU only, code/sn7_evidence_loss_v0.py
selectors: change_topk (mean absolute pixel difference to previous frame, computed from the same PNGs)

preservation_tiers.tierA_change_exists: selection contains both last_clear_no_change_id and first_change_id
preservation_tiers.tierB_first_claim: tierA and every observation from the reference up to first_change_id is present, so an earlier change cannot be hidden by the selection
preservation_tiers.tierC_human_set: selection is a superset of the annotator-agreed evidence_ids

metrics: preserved fraction per selector x budget x tier
minimum K at which each selector first reaches tierA for an episode
episodes where no selector reaches tierA at K=4

reading.loss_present: at K=4 the best simple selector preserves tierA on < 0.70 of change_supported episodes
reading.no_loss: at K=4 some simple selector preserves tierA on >= 0.90 of change_supported episodes

stage_L_evidence_loss.not_a_claim: this measures what a fixed-budget selection keeps, not any model's accuracy, and the episode count is small

stage_R_reader_content_check.runs_on: the diagnostic matrix produced by sn7_visible_pack_v05.py finalize, which scores the swap condition against the DONOR episode's own target
conditions: different_outcome_swap (source prompt, donor images, donor target)
stage_R_reader_content_check.decoding: greedy, max_new_tokens 256, JSON-only output as specified by the v0.5 prompt; unparsable output counts as wrong and is reported separately
metrics: first_change_id exact accuracy on change_supported episodes
swap_vs_donor_target (correct if the model follows the pixels) and swap_vs_source_target (correct if it follows the prompt/dates)
metadata_only and blank accuracy, which upper-bound what can be produced without pixels
stage_R_reader_content_check.content_use_criterion: swap_vs_donor_target - swap_vs_source_target >= 0.30 with an episode-level bootstrap CI excluding 0, for a reader to be called content-using on this data

reading.reads_content: content_use_criterion met and real-condition answer accuracy > metadata_only + 0.15
reading.does_not_read: criterion not met; that reader cannot be used to evaluate memory on this data

decision_table.next: close the SN7 memory line; the question is not consistently readable by people here
weak case for a new memory method on this data; pivot to a benchmark/reading paper

decision_table.observed: H passes, L says loss_present, R says reads_content
decision_table.next: enter the memory method experiment (online writer, no future frames, no question at write time)

decision_table.observed: H passes, L says loss_present, R says does_not_read
decision_table.next: reader alignment becomes a priced option, not an automatic next step; if taken it is ONE limited pilot with target-matched supervision and region-held-out evaluation

unlock_record.model_launch_allowed_after: stage H gate passes and the finalize step reports diagnostic_manifest_ready true
unlock_record.note: sn7_visible_pack_v05 writes allowed_for_model_run false on every matrix row by design; the runner flips it only when this prereg id and the matrix sha256 are recorded in the run output

not_allowed: changing the gates, tiers, budgets or criteria after seeing any result
training anything on the v0.5 annotator targets; they are evaluation gold
using the old silver definition (8-building cumulative month) anywhere in this experiment
reporting stage L or R if stage H failed
calling any outcome of this 12-episode development sample a general conclusion about EO VLMs or memory
compute: stage L is CPU minutes on a laptop; stage R is under 1 GPU-hour per reader
